svg.text: Borrowed-vehicle demand by hour and weekday, R = 60 min
Cell = most borrowed vehicles in use at once within the clock hour (route + 10-min cooldown); blank = none.
Monday to Friday of 2026-10-05..09; same colour scale in all panels; dashed line = 10:00.
